steps.title: Opening the camera app
steps.body: Find the camera icon 📷 on your phone and tap it. You'll now see what the camera sees. Tap the large round button at the bottom to take a photo.

steps.title: Switching between front and back camera
steps.body: Want to take a photo of yourself (a 'selfie')? Tap the rotate icon (two arrows in a circle) to switch between the front and back camera of your phone.

steps.title: Zooming in
steps.body: Place two fingers on the screen and move them apart to zoom in, or together to zoom out. This lets you make something further away appear larger in the frame.

steps.title: Exercise
steps.body: Take a photo below, or on your own phone, of something in the room around you.

steps.title: Opening the photo gallery
steps.body: All your photos are stored in the Photos app (Google Photos on Android, Photos on iPhone). Tap a photo to view it full-screen. Swipe left or right to browse through your photos.

steps.title: Cropping and rotating
steps.body: Open a photo and tap 'Edit' (often a small pencil icon). You can then crop the photo (remove part of it) or straighten it if it's crooked.

steps.title: Adjusting light and color
steps.body: In the same edit screen you'll usually find sliders for brightness and color. Slide them gently and see what changes. Not happy with the result? Tap 'Undo' or 'Cancel'.

steps.title: Exercise
steps.body: Open a photo from your own gallery and try making it a bit lighter or darker.

steps.title: Why an album is handy
steps.body: With hundreds of loose photos, it gets hard to find things. An album is a collection of photos around one theme, for example 'Vacation 2026' or 'Grandchildren'.

steps.title: Creating a new album
steps.body:
1. Open the Photos app
  2. Tap 'Album' or the plus sign (+)
  3. Give the album a name
  4. Choose the photos to include

steps.title: Adding photos later
steps.body: Viewing a photo and want to add it to an album after all? Tap the share icon or the three dots, and choose 'Add to album'.

steps.title: Exercise
steps.body: Create an album with a theme you like, and add two photos to it.

steps.title: Sharing one photo via WhatsApp
steps.body:
1. Open the photo
  2. Tap the share icon (often an arrow pointing up out of a square)
  3. Choose WhatsApp
  4. Choose the contact or group
  5. Tap send

steps.title: Sharing a whole album
steps.body: Want to share an entire album at once, for example with the whole family? Open the album and tap the share icon. You can then create a link that anyone can open, without having to send every photo separately.

steps.title: Getting prints made
steps.body: Want a photo on paper? Many drugstores and photo shops let you upload photos via their app or website and have them printed or ready for pickup in store.

steps.title: Exercise
steps.body: Share a photo from your album with a family member via WhatsApp.
